package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x, y := 3, 8
	p := &x
	q := p
	p = &y
	fmt.Println(*q)
	fmt.Println(*p)
}

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x, y := 1, 9
	p := &x
	pp := &p
	*pp = &y
	fmt.Println(*p)
}
